extraction.policy_summary: The Company states it is committed to equal opportunity for persons with disabilities in alignment with the RPwD Act, 2016, embedded in its Code of Conduct and its Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Policy; both are linked as web-accessible documents.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As of FY2025-26: 24 differently-abled employees, all permanent (16 male/66.7%, 8 female/33.3%), out of a total workforce of 38,894 employees. The filing notes these figures are based on voluntary disclosures by employees.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: At the corporate headquarters in Mumbai, specially designed washrooms are available on each side of every floor block for differently-abled individuals, including accessible doors, grab rails, and raised toilet seats. Common areas feature ramps, handrails, designed physical barriers, and dedicated accessible restrooms at the main entrance and shared spaces.
extraction.compliance_details: The Company states it has taken steps to ensure accessibility per the RPwD Act, 2016, and confirms it has an equal opportunity policy per the same Act, embedded in its Code of Conduct and DEI Policy. No RPwD Act employment-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is disclosed.

evidence.quote: Yes. The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity to all individuals, including persons with disabilities, in alignment with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. This commitment is embedded in its Code of Conduct as well as the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Policy.
Total differently abled employees (D + E)* 24 [16 Male/66.7%, 8 Female/33.3%]

At the corporate headquarters in Mumbai, specially designed washrooms are available on each side of every floor block to accommodate the needs of differently abled individuals. These facilities include accessible doors, grab rails, and raised toilet seats to ensure ease of use and safety.
Yes, the Company has taken steps to ensure accessibility in line with the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
